protocol.target_coverage: Every next-token target from index 1 through token_count - 1 is scored exactly once.
protocol.boundary_context: Each later window reuses only the preceding boundary token as unscored input context; target ranges never overlap and no target is counted twice.
protocol.tail_policy: The final window is shorter when needed; no overlapping final window is added.

metrics_definition.loss: Média ponderada da entropia cruzada em todos os alvos de próximo token, incluindo o EOS final.
metrics_definition.perplexity: exp(loss), calculada sobre a mesma média de loss.
metrics_definition.bits_per_byte: NLL dos tokens textuais, excluindo tokens especiais, dividida pelos bytes UTF-8 do texto limpo e por ln(2).
